lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a structured grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank, forming approximately four to five horizontal rows with vertical alignment in the region posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with faint horizontal lines of similar luminance, creating a lattice where high-intensity blobs are localized at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp pixel intensity transition from light-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to shadow-intensity pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, though the distal margin is truncated by the frame edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular tissue loss (notch) is present on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin; a dark vertical linear mark or deep skin fold is visible on the mid-flank posterior to the gills.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) attached to and swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin and lower flank.
